# Carolux Insulation LLC

> Owner-operated residential insulation contractor serving Charlotte, Gastonia, and the surrounding North Carolina Piedmont. Blown-in attic insulation, fiberglass batt, crawl space encapsulation and vapor barriers, and air sealing.

Carolux is run by its two owners, who are on site for every job: Tony Kermis, a former North Carolina home inspector, and Juan Gonzalez, who runs scheduling and customer care. Air sealing is included on every full insulation install at no extra charge. The company is fully insured and backs its work with a 2-year workmanship guarantee. Free, same-day written estimates.

## Services

- **Blown-In Attic Insulation** — Fiberglass or cellulose blown into the attic to the R-49 level the U.S. Department of Energy recommends for North Carolina. On every full install, air leaks are sealed first, at no extra charge.
- **Crawl Space & Vapor Barrier** — Crawl space encapsulation with a heavy-duty vapor barrier and perimeter insulation to keep moisture out and conditioned air in. Includes a full inspection and drainage assessment.
- **Fiberglass Batt Insulation** — Hand-fitted fiberglass batt set between crawl space floor joists to steady the floors above, soften sound between levels, and keep conditioned air where it belongs.

## Service Area

Charlotte, Huntersville, Pineville, Matthews, Mint Hill, Concord, Harrisburg, Belmont, Cramerton, Gastonia, Lowell, Mount Holly, and Stanley, NC — plus the surrounding Piedmont. Carolux is a service-area business that travels to the customer; there is no public storefront.
